## Description {#details}

<p>A pass which prints the call graph as a <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/dot">DOT</a> file to a <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/raw-ostream">raw_ostream</a></span>.</p>


<p>This is primarily useful for visualization purposes.</p>
